name: allowlister
//: The released crate: lib + bin `allowlister`, its unit tests and the in-process integration tests in tests/*.rs. As the root project it also owns every file no nested project claims (the justfile, docs, Cargo.lock), so a change to any of those reaches it and its dependents; its inputs are narrowed to what the crate compiles and tests from so cached lint/typecheck results survive a docs edit. tests/schema.rs reads the published schema, hence that one config-schema file among the inputs (an input, not an edge, so the schema validator's own changes never rerun this crate).

build.//: target/debug/allowlister: what allowlister-e2e:test depends on, so a broken binary build fails here, by name, before any journey runs.

test.//: Unit + integration tests under cargo-llvm-cov --no-report: the raw profiles land in target/llvm-cov-target for coverage:coverage to merge with the e2e crate's. Uncached (nx.json): a replay could not restore a profile set that matches this build.

release-check.//: The optimized release build plus the release plan (targets + packaging metadata) — the artifact checks, not a publish.

bench.//: Informational: never in the gate's target list (timings are noisy on shared hardware).
